original_approval.instruction:
你直接帮忙把所有Math-Vision题目都加入正式题库吧（mashpalette-publish），然后如果题目里面有<image1>这种标记要删去。
记得标记来源。

unique_answer_proof.independence: Any allowed interior front-face vertical at0<u<12 preserves the sum; actual drawing u=8 is schematic, not an extra given.

hypotheses_considered_and_rejected.hypothesis: Map the central front ascent to the far-right descent as one repeated height
hypotheses_considered_and_rejected.reason: They are different traversals with visible arrows and distinct endpoints. Merely coloring this pair to suggest counting once gives48but has no independent actual identity correspondence; no clean geometric justification beyond the desired error.

hypotheses_considered_and_rejected.hypothesis: Cancel the front down/up legs by direction
hypotheses_considered_and_rejected.reason: Displacement differs from route length, but cancelling both12legs yields36, which is absent. To force48one would have to suppress only one leg without a meaningful matched feature.

hypotheses_considered_and_rejected.hypothesis: Bind front horizontal complementary parts as a single side
hypotheses_considered_and_rejected.reason: This is a true invariant and supports60, as in the old assessment. A new color grouping would only repeat that old considered idea.

hypotheses_considered_and_rejected.hypothesis: Use projected diagonal as a side-length/face-diagonal correspondence
hypotheses_considered_and_rejected.reason: The route follows actual cube edges/vertical meridian, not a surface diagonal. Adding a diagonal or replacing a route segment would change the original problem geometry.

reason_for_no_forced_call: No clean materially new hypothesis after finite review; no hiding arrows/traversals, no new numerical length condition.
